'''June 2001 Lexington tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hit and Run, Lexington, MA on 22 June 2001. [[Stephen Cellucci]] won it. It is known from Stephen Cellucci's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2532">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-26-lexington-ma-6-22-01-aka-superscrublandd2532/ lexington-ma-6-22-01-aka-superscrubland], DeckTech (Stephen "The Gov'na" Cellucci, 26 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-26-lexington-ma-6-22-01-aka-superscrublandd2532/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Hit and Run, Lexington, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Stephen Cellucci]]
